description: SYNTHETIC evaluation set for the contradiction detector (ADR-019, M5.5 PR 4). Every note it points at is fictional and labelled synthetic. Not frozen: the freeze is chunk 4c.

schema.label: conflict | no_conflict: the owner's reading of the two statements
schema.expected_status: what the finished design should end with for a model that behaves: VALUE_CONFLICT, CANDIDATE, NOT_PAIRED (code must not pair them) or EXCLUDED (framework text, never compared)
schema.offline_status: what the code half alone must produce, with no model: CANDIDATE (found, flagged model_not_consulted), NOT_PAIRED or EXCLUDED. Never VALUE_CONFLICT
schema.chunk_a / chunk_b: path (relative to fixtures/vault-contradictions), the lines of the statement, and the phrase: the statement as written, found verbatim in those lines

known_cases.note: D-06, a dev item of the M5 set (eval-set.json:138). Found by code alone.

chunk_b.phrase: security logs are kept for 365 days
